regions.explanation: At 50.73s, the onset of “seven” is repeated 2 time(s) before the word is completed (fragment-to-onset spectral similarity 0.89). Repeated onsets before the word is completed fragment it and interrupt the speech rhythm. Fix: Begin the word once, deliberately; a short breath before it helps.
